source_definitions.name: dic_canonical_roaster_key
source_definitions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.dic_canonical_roaster_key(value text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 with input as (select private.dic_roaster_key(value) as key)
 select coalesce(
   (select a.canonical_key from private.dic_roaster_name_aliases a
      join input i on i.key=a.alias_key limit 1),
   (select key from input)
 );
$function$

source_definitions.name: dic_roaster_key
source_definitions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.dic_roaster_key(value text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select nullif(regexp_replace(
  regexp_replace(lower(extensions.unaccent(coalesce(value,''))), '[^a-z0-9]', '', 'g'),
  '(coffeeroasters|coffeeroaster|coffeeroastery|coffeecompany|coffeeco|roasters|roaster|roastery|coffee)$',
  ''
 ), '');
$function$

source_definitions.name: session_status
source_definitions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.session_status()
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
select jsonb_build_object(
 'authenticated',auth.uid() is not null,
 'admitted',private.is_member(),
 'admin',private.is_admin(),
 'emailVerified',exists(select 1 from auth.users u where u.id=auth.uid() and u.email_confirmed_at is not null),
 'approvalState',coalesce((
   select case when m.admitted_at is not null and m.enabled then 'approved'
     when m.admitted_at is not null then 'revoked'
     else m.signup_review_state end
   from private.beta_members m where m.owner_id=auth.uid()),'pending'),
 'backupConfigured',false,'communityLive',false,'mode','owner-test');
$function$
